subject: Annual review cycle: comms, data flow & sign-off checklist
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft comms + data flow ask for review cycle

Team —

Thanks for the quick sync last week. I've pulled together a short comms draft and an initial data-flow map for the review window. Primary asks here:

- Can DPE and People Ops confirm the minimum retention period we need to call out in comms? (we proposed 90 days for working artifacts, 1 year for final ratings)
- Marcus: can you validate that the proposed data exports are scoped correctly for managers only?
- Jasmine: would you take point on the manager email templates and tests?

I've attached: review_forms_v2.pdf (cleaned up questions), data_flow_map.xlsx (showing which systems store comment artifacts), and a comms draft in Google Doc (link below).

Please reply with redlines by EOD Wed (6/30) so we can finalize for ELT review.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: review_forms_v2.pdf, data_flow_map.xlsx
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft comms + data flow ask for review cycle

Thanks Laura — quick notes after a pass this morning:

- Retention: legal confirmed we should call out a 9-month retention for draft artifacts (instead of 90 days) to cover audit requests. I'll update the comms language accordingly.
- Manager email templates: I'll draft 3 variants (all-managers, managers-of-people-leaders, IC-only managers) and include micro-copy for the subject lines and CTA buttons.
- Testing: I'd like to run a small A/B of subject lines with 50 managers before the full send; can we get a test list from Marcus?

I attached one suggested subject line set to the Google Doc. I'm fine with the proposed ratings wording but will soften the phrasing around forced distribution — want to avoid unnecessary anxiety.

Jasmine Liu
Director, Employee Experience
Redwood Inference

From: Melissa Hart <melissa@compasshr.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft comms + data flow ask for review cycle — consultant notes

Hi team —

Appreciate the share. A few practical suggestions from our end after reviewing the attached forms and map:

1) Timeline compression: If ELT sign-off slips past 7/15 we should move the manager send to 8/10 to preserve manager prep time. Recommend we lock ELT deck by 7/12.
2) Data minimization: Where possible, avoid including full comment history in the manager summary export — provide a 200-word excerpt and link to a secure viewer. This reduces risk and storage cost.
3) Audit trail: Add a single checkbox on the manager form to confirm they reviewed calibration guidance; that becomes an auditable event.

I've redlined the Google Doc (link) and attached a one-page timeline PDF. Also happy to join a brief sync with ELT to walk through risk points.

Best,
Melissa Hart
Senior Consultant, CompassHR

Attachments: compass_timeline_onepage.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 14:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft comms + data flow ask for review cycle — dev constraints

Jasmine / Laura —

Went through data_flow_map.xlsx with infra. Quick feasibility notes:

- Manager export: we can produce a manager-only CSV with rating, summary excerpt and link; timeline to build and test is ~10 business days once spec is approved.
- Secure viewer link: requires a short-lived pre-signed URL flow. We can reuse an existing signed-url service but need a single integration ticket.
- Test cohort: I can produce the 50-manager test list if People Ops provides the manager population filter (active managers, >6 direct reports).

Action items:
- Laura: confirm the manager population filter by 7/15.
- Jasmine: share A/B subject lines by 7/16 so engineering can wire tracking for the test.

Marcus Lin
Sr. Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

> > Thanks Laura — quick notes after a pass this morning...
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Melissa Hart <melissa@compasshr.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Finalized timeline and sign-off owners for review rollout

Team —

Thanks for the rapid turns. Final decisions we landed on in the ELT prep call today:

- ELT lock date: 2026-07-12 (met)
- Manager test send: 2026-07-22 to 50 managers (run for 72 hours)
- Full manager send: 2026-08-10
- Retention language: 9 months for drafts, 12 months for final ratings (as Jasmine updated)
- Audit checkbox: included on manager form per Melissa's suggestion

Owners / approvers:
- Messaging & A/B: Jasmine Liu (approver: Laura Bennett)
- Export & viewer integration: Marcus Lin (approver: Karthik Iyer)
- Legal & retention: Laura Bennett (approver: GC office)

Next steps: Marcus to create the integration ticket (JIRA-HR-457) and add an estimated effort. Jasmine — please drop the three subject-line variants and final templates into the Google Doc by EOD Wed (7/21). Melissa — appreciate availability to join ELT sync on 7/21 at 10am PT; invite to follow.

I'll circulate the finalized comms pack and the manager testing checklist after Jasmine's update.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
